label: Post-hoc measurement after the V6 freeze; changes no recorded result
method: Each instance ran three rounds per engine in alternating order on identical inputs (input.zip SHA-256 in each state.json). Kernels: median of seven timed batches; 1080p and 2160p frames are tiled from the 960 x 640 panel frames. Prices: AWS Price List API, us-east-1 on-demand Linux, effective 2026-10-01; COOL fee from its Marketplace listing.
